description:
In FEED MY MECH you are entombed in a clunky war machine doomed to wander the labyrinths of the old human colonies and fight what appears to be rogue Angels and possibly Choo Choo Charles. The strangest baby Five Nights at Freddy's 2 and Iron Lung ever had.
